answer: Locks are published in vine, expire in terrace, and orchard lists each expiry. An adversary running 160 aliases therefore needs 185 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1817 identities would post 4170 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
